zh-CN.settings.hooks.agy.title: Antigravity CLI Hook 桥接
zh-CN.settings.hooks.agy.description: 检查或更改所选环境中的回调。不会更改状态栏或其他 CLI 的配置。
zh-CN.settings.hooks.agy.enableHint: 适用于新启动的本机和 WSL 终端。关闭后立即忽略事件，但保留已安装的回调。
zh-CN.settings.hooks.agy.distrosUnavailable: 无法列出 WSL 发行版。请确认 WSL 可用后重新打开此页。
zh-CN.settings.hooks.agy.error: 无法读取或更新此环境的 Hook 配置。请检查路径与权限后重试。
zh-CN.settings.hooks.agy.conflict: 配置冲突：未覆盖现有配置，请先检查文件。
zh-CN.settings.hooks.agy.manage: 打开设置，检查本机或指定 WSL 发行版的 agy 回调
zh-CN.settings.hooks.agy.eventsTitle: 观测事件（统一安装 / 卸载）
zh-CN.settings.hooks.agy.notesInstalledEntry: ~/.gemini/config/hooks.json 注册 cli-manager-antigravity 回调（SessionStart / PreInvocation / Stop）
zh-CN.settings.hooks.agy.notesInstalledScope: 按所选本机或 WSL 发行版隔离写入，不改动状态栏或其他 CLI 配置
zh-CN.settings.hooks.agy.notesKeptUser: 仅管理本应用标记条目，保留用户和其他工具的现有 Hook
zh-CN.settings.hooks.agy.notesKeptConflict: 检测到配置冲突时不会覆盖原文件，请检查 hooks.json 后重试
zh-CN.settings.hooks.agy.actionFailedToast: 操作 Antigravity CLI Hook 失败

en-US.settings.hooks.agy.title: Antigravity CLI Hook Bridge
en-US.settings.hooks.agy.description: Inspect or change callbacks in the selected environment. This does not change the statusline or another CLI’s configuration.
en-US.settings.hooks.agy.enableHint: Applies to new local and WSL terminals. Turning this off ignores events immediately but leaves installed callbacks in place.
en-US.settings.hooks.agy.distrosUnavailable: Could not list WSL distributions. Check that WSL is available and reopen this page.
en-US.settings.hooks.agy.error: Could not read or update the hook configuration for this environment. Check the path and permissions, then retry.
en-US.settings.hooks.agy.conflict: Configuration conflict: existing entries were not overwritten. Review the file first.
en-US.settings.hooks.agy.manage: Open settings to check agy callbacks on this machine or in a named WSL distribution
en-US.settings.hooks.agy.notesInstalledEntry: Registers cli-manager-antigravity callbacks (SessionStart / PreInvocation / Stop) in ~/.gemini/config/hooks.json
en-US.settings.hooks.agy.notesInstalledScope: Scoped per local host or selected WSL distribution; does not touch statusline or other CLIs
en-US.settings.hooks.agy.notesKeptUser: Manages only CLI-Manager owned entries and preserves user or third-party hooks
en-US.settings.hooks.agy.notesKeptConflict: Never overwrites conflicting entries; review hooks.json and retry
en-US.settings.hooks.agy.actionFailedToast: Failed to update Antigravity CLI Hook
